subject: Can the character limit be changed?

messages.author: 224ed070a9fc9c49
messages.subject: Can the character limit be changed?
parts:
Dear Subread Group

   For our specific need, our chromosome name is long...

   Can this be changed ?



Thank You Very Much...

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: Can the character limit be changed?
parts:
If you built the package from the source codes, there is a macro named "MAX_CHROMOSOME_NAME_LEN" defined in src/subread.h. The default value is 100.

You may change its value to suit your chromosome names, and recompile the package. It is suggested not to change it larger than 200.
